typedChecks.evidence_quote: Adult subjects (18 years and older) with newly diagnosed early stage, locally advanced or metastatic non-small cell lung cancer

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Must be eligible for systemic therapy based on the treating provider's assessment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Investigator discretion regarding systemic therapy eligibility is subjective and not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects who developed locally advanced or metastatic disease after receiving adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy are eligible if the adjuvant/neoadjuvant therapy was completed at least 12 months prior to the development of locally advanced or metastatic disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This rule involves a specific washout/completion window relative to the development of advanced disease, which cannot be expressed using a single typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects must be enrolled within 30 days of initiation of systemic therapy
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Enrollment timing relative to treatment start is a study logistics rule, not an eligibility check kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with small cell lung cancer
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Small cell lung cancer is a histologic exclusion outside of the allowed histologies list.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with Unknown primary tumor origin
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Unknown primary tumor origin is a diagnostic criterion, not a typed NSCLC histology or stage check.
